text:
Irene (sec): quick heads-up — we're planning the base-image cutover next Thu. Need alignment on three things: RBAC for the image-bake SA, KMS signing key placement, and audit retention after the rebuild. TL;DR: want to avoid a follow-on rollback scramble.
Alex (eng): fwiw the bake jobs run in CI runners vs a dedicated image-builder k8s job. if we scope RBAC to CI runners today it's a huge blast radius.
Ted (infra): can we give the image-builder service-account just `storage.objects.get` + `storage.objects.create` on the build-bucket and `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` only for the cosign signer role? trying to keep least-privilege but not break automation.
Sachin (security): that sounds close. two concerns: (1) KMS key material — do we want cosign KMS-wrapped keys in our central KMS or a per-environment key? (2) audit logs: build artifacts and signature writes must be retained for 1y for compliance, not 30d.
Linda (oncall): +1 for 1y. And also add an alert if signature writes start failing — last time it was a transient IAM deny and nobody noticed until deploy.
deploy-bot: build/12345 started by @alex (eng)
Alex (eng): on KMS: ops prefers a central key with restricted access (keystore-admin + image-signing role). pros: easier rotation and monitoring. cons: single key = single blast.
Irene (sec): proposal: central KMS key with per-environment key encryption keys (KEKs) so we can rotate env-level KEKs if needed. image-builder SA gets Encrypt/Decrypt on the per-environment key only. Keystore-admin group keeps IAM to central key. Thoughts?
Sachin (security): sounds ok. we should also ensure cosign signing uses KMS-backed key versioning (not local key files). update policy to reject unsigned images in gating stage.
Ted (infra): implementable. infra plan: 
```
- create `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/prod-image-signer`
- grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `svc-image-builder@...` on that key
- restrict `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyAdmin` to `grp-keystore-admin@redwood`
```
Alex (eng): for RBAC on registry: recommend a registry-scoped role `roles/storage.objectCreator` on the `image-bucket/prod/` prefix + IAM condition to only allow uploads where `request.auth.claims.service_account == svc-image-builder`. avoids giving runners write rights.
Irene (sec): what about rollout rollback scenarios? if we need to rollback and re-sign older images, who has permission?
Sachin (security): only keystore-admins. we should require a JIT approval for re-sign operations and log the approval to the same audit trail.
Linda (oncall): also: set up alert on KMS key usage spikes and `sign` errors. put basic runbook in the incident channel.
Alex (eng): tiny technical ask: cosign + KMS requires the key version resource path in the signing cmd. sample we tested: `cosign sign --kms projects/.../cryptoKeys/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1 gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:...`
Irene (sec): ok actionable list — I'll summarize: 
- Ted: provision per-env KMS key ring + set grants (ETA Tue)
- Alex: change registry IAM condition and update CI to use `svc-image-builder` for prod bakes (ETA Wed)
- Sachin: add gating rule to reject unsigned images and JIT flow for re-signs (ETA Thu)
- Linda: create alerts + runbook for KMS/sign failures (ETA Wed)
- Irene: draft short RFC and a compliance checklist (audit retention 1y) and open follow-up PRs (ETA Mon)
Sachin (security): small nit — also include `principalSet` deny for service accounts outside `svc-image-builder` in the bucket policy. reduces accidental writes.
Ted (infra): noted. Will also add a test that simulates an IAM deny and confirms alert triggers.
Irene (sec): ok let's treat this as the canonical preflight thread. if anyone has objections to the plan above, reply now. otherwise I'll open the RFC and tag owners. :thumbsup:
